Olivia (eng-release): Heads up — starting region-by-region rollout tonight. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Deploy bot scheduled 2026-03-20 23:00 UTC. Pin v2.14.1. Need confirmation on warm pools, reserved GPUs, and any scheduled jobs in EU window. @Nate @Mira @Sam

deploy-bot: deploy-bot queued rollout request from Olivia for v2.14.1. Canary 5% in US for 15m then ramp. Will post checkpoints.

Nate (oncall): Confirming warm pool counts: US: 40 GPUs warm, EU: 18 GPUs warm, APAC: 12 GPUs warm. Reserved slots available: US 10, EU 6, APAC 4.

Mira (infra): infra will hold back 2 extra nodes in EU for 30m post-canary. K8s prep/pulls running. Quick kube snippet + output: ```kubectl get nodes -l role=warmpool -o wide
NAME         STATUS
warm-us-01   Ready
warm-eu-01   Ready
warm-apac-02 Ready```

Sam (sre): SRE note: set circuit threshold to 4xx > 0.8% OR p95 latency > 1.2s for 10m -> automatic rollback. Also enable model fallback to quantized variant (q4) in EU/APAC if tail lat spikes.

Olivia (eng-release): Rollback triggers ack'd. Pin traffic split: US canary 70% -> ramp, EU 20% then pause, APAC 10% (manual). Release notes: minor KV cache perf fixes + kernel selection tweak. QA smoke command: `./scripts/rollout-smoke.sh --region eu`

Mira (infra): Smoke run results: 200/200 sample requests passed, avg latency eu 220ms. Pushing ingress rule to limit burst from internal jobs: ```ingress rule snippet
- from: jobs-internal
  action: throttle
  rate: 60%```

Nate (oncall): @Olivia we'll keep an eye on billing and preemptible eviction risk. If reserved drops below 3 GPUs in APAC, abort APAC step and notify.

Olivia (eng-release): :thumbsup: all set. I will start the deploy at 23:00 UTC. @deploy-bot kick off at scheduled time and ping here at canary start and ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment started for v2.14.1 — canary US 5% live. Monitoring hooks engaged. Logs: https://deploys.example.com/plot/4890123456
If rollback triggered, run `/deploy rollback v2.14.0 --reason=auto`.

Sam (sre): Observed a small error spike at 23:06 UTC in US (0.5% 5xx), investigating. Hold ramp.

Olivia (eng-release): Holding ramp. Nate / Mira please check warm pool drain and any autoscale events.

Nate (oncall): No autoscale events. I see a flurry of internal rerank jobs hitting US cluster, throttling set to 60%.

Mira (infra): Scaled ingress limiter to block internal jobs, freed ~8 GPUs. Standby for ramp resume.

Olivia (eng-release): Resume ramp when stable for 15m and p95 < 900ms. I'll update release notes with timeline.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary resumed and ramping to 30% in US. Next checkpoint in +20m.
